name: Tobia's Animal Farm
source:
Coming home late at night, the last thing Hel expected was to see her daughter waiting for her - She wants to read a bedtime story together!

[from [url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/tobias-animal-farm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
深夜回到家，赫尔最没想到的就是看到女儿在等她——她想和她一起读睡前故事！

[来自[url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/tobias-animal-farm]Itch.io[/url]]
